description: Imports a company template from a Google Slides presentation, as the app's Templates drawer does: its theme, slide masters, layouts and slide size, not its slides. The presentation is read with the user's Google account connected to Rollstack. Over REST, you can instead send a PowerPoint file as multipart/form-data in the file field: a .pptx of at most 100 MB, named after the file and kept to the user until shared with updateTemplate. Answers the template as listTemplates lists it, to pass as templateId to createReport or applyReportTemplate.

googleSlidesId.description: The Google Slides presentation to import the look of, by its link or its id: the part after `/presentation/d/` in the link. It's read with your Google account connected to Rollstack, so you must be able to open it.

name.description: The template's name, as members will see it in Rollstack.

sharedWithOrganization.description: Whether everyone in the organization can use the template, or only you. Only admins can share a template with the organization; a template's creator can stop sharing it. Defaults to `false`.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

name: createTemplate
title: Import template
